_about: Canonical desired protection for main. BurnBar CI Gate is the single always-emitted required context; it fails closed over the component contexts in governance/burnbar-ci-gate.json. Native merge queue rules are layered separately. Conversation resolution, no force pushes, no deletion, and exact-current-base checks remain hard gates.
_derivation: Reconciled for the solo-maintainer native merge queue and path-aware umbrella gate on 2026-07-21. Component checks remain mandatory through BurnBar CI Gate while expensive product suites may report skipped only when the deterministic classifier proves their paths are unaffected.

_pending_required_status_checks._comment: Component contexts are enforced by governance/burnbar-ci-gate.json, not classic branch protection. These remain informational or path-scoped.
